title: The policy wiki, question by question

steps.title: Q1 Existing option
steps.body: No native connector exists for the in-house wiki.

steps.title: Q2 Data shape
steps.body: Policy and runbook pages: documents, not rows or telemetry.

steps.title: Q3 Need
steps.body: Staff ask policy questions and need citations across many pages: an indexed use case.

steps.title: Q4 Data types
steps.body: The API exposes pages, users, groups with members, and deletions. It exposes no activity, so expect weaker ranking.

steps.title: Q5 Ownership
steps.body: The partner builds it and must name who supports it after go-live.

steps.title: Decision
steps.body: Custom indexed connector. Record the rejected alternatives and why.
